identity: Likely Two Rudy Wiedoeft Classics: Valse Mazanetta and Saxema, edited Ted Hegvik
findings: A2003 advertisement names Two Rudy Wiedoeft Classics for alto saxophone and piano, Valse Mazanetta and Saxema, edited by Ted Hegvik, published through Et Cetera Productions. This closely matches the catalog's compressed title.
The two are separate compositions in a paired edition. Mazane appears to be a truncation of Mazanetta.

Other current editions differ: Lyrical Music offers Valse Mazanetta for B-flat tenor or soprano and piano, and Saxema for C-melody saxophone and piano. These alternatives should not replace the likely Hegvik alto edition.
The Clarinet Classics historical reissue Kreisler of the Saxophone lists Rudy Wiedoeft performing Valse Mazanetta (2:58) and Saxema (2:48).
